column1: # Market declares the two per-store strings plus one derived flag; DesktopLauncher selects the
# store by matching a() against "Review"/"NobleMaster"/... and BootScreen logs a(), so
#   b() -> getUrl (Review returns the noble master home page, NobleMasterMarket the purchase URL
#   c() -> hasUrl (true when b() is non-null)
# Every concrete market repeats the same two overrides, so one naming covers the hierarchy.
